member of the Gosling Society

A Gosling as ‘Mayfly’ in December 1876, she was daughter of the Rev. Edward Marshall (ne Marshall-Hacker, 1815-1899) former fellow of Corpus Christi and squire of Sandford, who published extensively on theology and local history [Alumni Oxonienses; Marshall, Parish of Sandford;  1881 census, BBI]
